headword: {国際|こくさい}{郵便|ゆうびん}

definitions.explanation: Mail sent to or received from another country. Covers letters, parcels, and other postal items crossing international borders.

examples.japanese: {国際|こくさい}{郵便|ゆうびん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{送|おく}る→送る：00742_okuru⟧。
{国際|こくさい}{郵便|ゆうびん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{届|とど}く→届く：00899_todoku⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧1⟦{週間|しゅうかん}→週間：00988_shuukan⟧⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: International mail takes about a week to arrive.

examples.japanese: ⟦{郵便局|ゆうびんきょく}→郵便局：00579_yuubinkyoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{国際|こくさい}{郵便|ゆうびん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{料金|りょうきん}→料金：03797_ryoukin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}いた→聞く：00483_kiku⟧。
examples.english: I asked about international mail rates at the post office.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{国際|こくさい}→国際：01406_kokusai⟧ (international) and ⟦{郵便|ゆうびん}→郵便：03803_yuubin⟧ (mail/postal service). Japan Post offers several international mail services with varying speeds and prices.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {国際|こくさい}{郵便|ゆうびん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{送|おく}る→送る：00742_okuru⟧: to send by international mail
- {国際|こくさい}{郵便|ゆうびん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{料金|りょうきん}→料金：03797_ryoukin⟧: international postage rates
- {国際|こくさい}{郵便|ゆうびん}⟦{小包|こづつみ}→小包：02764_kozutsumi⟧: international parcel

TYPES OF INTERNATIONAL MAIL:
- EMS (⟦{国際|こくさい}→国際：01406_kokusai⟧⟦スピード→スピード：11048_supiido⟧⟦{郵便|ゆうびん}→郵便：03803_yuubin⟧): Express Mail Service — the fastest option
- ⟦{航空便|こうくうびん}→航空便：24353_koukuubin⟧: airmail — standard international airmail
- ⟦{船便|ふなびん}→船便：20345_funabin⟧: surface mail / sea mail — cheapest but slowest
- SAL{便|びん}: economy airmail — between airmail and surface mail in speed and price

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{国内|こくない}→国内：02998_kokunai⟧⟦{郵便|ゆうびん}→郵便：03803_yuubin⟧: domestic mail — mail within Japan
